components.purpose: The core 'How it works' section: a numbered Process component (Heading + StepItems) that lays out the three steps in order: 1. Sign up, 2. Connect your data, 3. Publish. Its own Heading field carries the 'How it works' title, so no separate header is needed.

A closing call-to-action banner with a heading, description, and Primary/Secondary buttons, so readers can act on the flow (e.g. 'Sign up' as the primary button). Placed after the steps, it gives the section an ending action.
